description: Release scoreboard rows: Doe (doe-gpu) versus Dawn (webgpu npm package) in the same Node harness. Every row is required for a release performance claim; see config/release-scoreboard.json.

workloads.name: Qwen 3.5 2B warm decode, 64 tokens
workloads.description: Resident-weight decode tokens/s for qwen-3-5-2b-q4k-ehaf16 after one identical warmup generation: 64 greedy tokens after a 17-token prompt. Timing is ms per decoded token over the first-to-last token window.
workloads.comparabilityNotes: Same Node harness, Doppler source, tracked model manifest and verified shards, prompt, greedy sampling and stopping on both providers; the provider module is the only intended difference. Output check: generated token ids equal across providers (comparator result-output equality) and equal to the backend's recorded reference (executor). The WGSL module and pipeline set must match across providers (shader receipt).
